oulad.justification: Totals, last activity day, engagement slope over the full presentation all embed the future (and the absence of clicks after withdrawal).

OULAD has no score RELEASE date; assuming the score is known on submission day is optimistic. Phase 03 must test a release lag (e.g. +7/+14 days).

oulad.variable: count/mean of assessments over the whole presentation
oulad.justification: Missing submissions after withdrawal mechanically encode the outcome.

oulad.variable: presentation-level withdrawal rate of the SAME presentation
oulad.justification: Target encoding with the evaluated cohort's own labels.

oulad.variable: statistics from PREVIOUS presentations (e.g. module historic withdrawal rate)
oulad.justification: Allowed if computed only from presentations that finished before the predicted one starts.
Must use only data <= cutoff and be fitted on training presentations only.

Some students appear in more than one presentation (count in research/inspection/phase02_oulad.json): train/test must split by student and/or by time, otherwise the model sees the same person on both sides.
